summary: No performance findings. The contract checks are field presence and set membership over a roadmap measured in tens of items, run only at the three authoring routes. check_epic_contract resolves source_refs with one filesystem stat per reference, and import re-checks only the stored epics that incoming stories actually name — deliberately not the whole stored list, so one stale epic elsewhere cannot slow or refuse an unrelated import.
residual_risks: doctor's advisory walks every roadmap item on each run. Linear in story count on a human-triggered command.
